t: Delhi ke badhte pollution ke kaaran ab log Jaipur shift ho rahe hain.
In chaar kaarano ki wajah se Delhi har saal gas chamber ban jaati hai.
Number one, sardiyon mein hawa north-west se, Punjab aur Haryana ki taraf se aati hai. Wahan parali jalti hai, aur yeh dhuaan seedha Delhi ki taraf aata hai. Jaipur is raste mein nahi padta.
Reason two, Delhi Indo-Gangetic maidan mein hai. Hawa dheemi chalti hai, aur pollution jaise ek katori mein band ho jaata hai.
Reason three, sardi mein high pressure aur thandi hawa zameen ke paas rehti hai, aur garam hawa upar se ek dhakkan bana leti hai, jo dhuaan ko upar nahi jaane deti.

Reason four, Jaipur samudra tal se karib 430 meter upar hai, jabki Delhi sirf 215 meter. Aravali ki pahadiyan, aas paas ke khule ilaake aur tez chalti hawa Jaipur se pollution jaldi saaf kar deti hai.
Par dhyaan rakhein, sardiyon mein Jaipur ka AQI bhi thoda kharab hota hai, zyaadatar dhool ke kaaran, lekin Delhi jitna bilkul nahi.
Isliye saaf hawa, kam bheed aur Delhi se sirf kuch ghante ki doori. In sab reasons ki wajah se log Jaipur mein aake ghar le rahe hain.
Kya aap bhi Delhi se Jaipur shift hone ka soch rahe hain? Comment karein.
